title: BOOSTER: TACKLING HARMFUL FINE-TUNING FOR LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS VIA ATTENUATING HARMFUL PERTURBATION
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical defense mechanism for safety alignment in Large Language Models to prevent alignment-breaking through harmful fine-tuning. It evaluates safety using a moderation model to detect unsafe outputs (e.g., instructions for illegal acts) rather than benchmarking philosophical ethics, moral frameworks, or religious values.
